title: Income Tax Department Bars Officials from Sharing Taxpayer Data with AI Tools (Circular No. 1/2026)
content:
# Income Tax Department Bars Officials from Sharing Taxpayer Data with AI Tools (Circular No. 1/2026)

Ek important update hai. Government ne taxpayer data confidentiality aur data security maintain karne ke liye ek naya advisory announce kiya hai.

The Income Tax Department ne Circular No. 1/2026, dated September 14, 2026, issued kiya hai, jismein tax officials ko taxpayer data AI tools ke saath share karne se roka gaya hai.

**Key Highlights of the Circular:**

*   **Confidentiality First:** Circular emphasize karta hai ki taxpayer confidentiality, data security, aur officers ka independent decision-making compromise nahi hona chahiye for convenience.
*   **Strict Prohibitions:** Officers aur staff ko explicitly prohibit kiya gaya hai taxpayer-related information ko kisi bhi public ya commercial AI tool, chatbot, generative AI platform, document analyzer, summarizer, translation or transcription service, ya cloud-based analytical software par transmit karne se.
*   **Methods Covered:** Yeh prohibition includes sharing data by typing, pasting, uploading, scanning, photographing, dictating, or transcribing.
*   **Personal Accountability:** Circular clear karta hai ki responsibility compliance ki individual officers par hogi, aur unauthorized sharing ya disclosure par penal action ho sakta hai.
*   **Limited AI Use:** Generic research, drafting, aur administrative tasks ke liye AI ka use allowed hai, but sensitive taxpayer data unauthorized external platforms par share nahi hona chahiye.

Yeh move taxpayer data ki security aur departmental integrity maintain karne ke liye ek crucial step hai, especially with the increasing use of AI in tax administration.
